title: Brahma orders the gods to be born as vanaras
introduction: The gods become progenitors Vanara heroes at the dictate of Brahma to come to the aid of Rama in annihilating Ravana. The monkey-like Vanara race is procreated by numerous celestials endowing it with peculiar mighty physique and particular power to come to the help of Rama.
closing: इति वाल्मीकिरामायणे आदिकाव्ये बालकाण्डे सप्तदशः सर्गः ||
Thus, this is the 17th chapter in Bala Kanda of Valmiki Ramayana,the First Epic poem of India.

verses.devanagari:
पुत्रत्वं तु गते विष्णौ राज्ञस्तस्य महात्मनः |
उवाच देवताः सर्वाः स्वयंभूर्भगवानिदम्
verses.iast:
putratvam tu gate viṣṇau rājñaḥ tasya mahātmanaḥ |
uvāca devatāḥ sarvāḥ svayambhūḥ bhagavān idam
verses.translation: When Vishnu attained the sonship of the great-souled king Dasharatha, then Brahma the self-created addressed all of the gods this way.

glosses.meaning: Vishnu's, that, king's, sonship, when attained

verses.devanagari:
सत्यसंधस्य वीरस्य सर्वेषां नो हितैषिणः |
विष्णोः सहायान् बलिनः सृजध्वं कामरूपिणः
verses.iast:
satya sandhasya vīrasya sarveṣām no hitaiṣiṇaḥ |
viṣṇoḥ sahāyān balinaḥ sṛjadhvam kāma rūpiṇaḥ
verses.translation: "Let mighty and guise changing helpmates be procreated to that truth abiding and valorous Vishnu who is the well-wisher of all of us.

verses.devanagari:
मायाविदश्च शूरांश्च वायुवेगसमान् जवे |
नयज्ञान् बुद्धिसंपन्नान् विष्णुतुल्यपराक्रमान्
असंहार्यानुपायज्ञान् दिव्यसंहननान्वितान् |
सर्वास्त्रगुणसंपन्नानमृतप्राशनानिव
अप्सरस्सु च मुख्यासु गन्धर्वीणां तनूषु च |
यक्षपन्नगकन्यासु ऋक्षविद्याधरीषु च
किंनरीणां च गात्रेषु वानरीणां तनूषु च |
सृजध्वं हरिरूपेण पुत्रांस्तुल्यपराक्रमान्
verses.iast:
māyā vidaḥ ca śūrām ca vāyu vega samān jave |
nayajñān buddhi sampannān viṣṇu tulya parākramān
asaṃhāryān upāyajñān divya saṃhanana anvitān |
sarva astra guṇa sampannānan amṛta prāśanān iva
apsarassu ca mukhyāsu gandharvāṇām tanūṣu ca |
yakśa pannaga kanyāsu ṛkśa vidyādharīṣu ca
kiṃnarīṇām ca gātreṣu vānarīnām tanūsu ca |
sṛjadhvam hari rūpeṇa putrān tulya parākramān
verses.translation: "Let monkey-shaped progeny equalling Vishnu's valour be procreated from the physiques of prominent apsara-s and gandharva-s, from the girls of yaksha-s and pannaga-s, and also thus from the bodies of kinnaraa-s, she-vidyaadharaa-s, she-riksha-s and she-monkeys, and they shall be wizards of miracles and audacious ones, in travel they shall have air's speed, bestowed with intellect they shall be the knowers of ideation, and with their divine physique they shall be ineliminable, they shall be endowed with all the assaultive aspects of all missiles, and they shall be untiring in their efforts, like you who thrive on amrita, the ambrosia, unmindful of thirst and hunger.
notes: Gandharva-s (Southey's Glendoveers) are celestial musicians inhabiting Indra's heaven and forming the orchestra at all the banquets of the principal deities. Yaksha-s, demigods attendant especially on Kubera, and employed by him in the care of his garden and treasures. Kimpurusha-s, demigods attached also to the service of Kubera, celestial musicians, represented like centaurs reversed with human figures and horses' heads. Siddha-s, are demigods or spirits of undefined attributes, occupying with the Vidyaadharaa-s the middle air or region between the earth and the sun. Griffith.

glosses.meaning: in travel, air's, speed, equivalent to
ambrosia, drinkers, like tulya paraakramaan = equalling, [your] valour [godly, like you hunger-less thirst-less gods]
in prominent, apsara-s, in celestial courtesans

verses.devanagari:
पूर्वमेव मया सृष्टो जांबवानृक्षपुङ्गवः |
जृंभमाणस्य सहसा मम वक्रादजायत
verses.iast:
pUrvam eva mayā sṛṣṭo jāmbavān ṛxa puñgavaḥ |
jṛmbhamāṇasya sahasā mama vakrāt ajāyata
verses.translation: "I have already created the eminent bear Jambavanta in earlier times, as he suddenly came forth from my yawning face.
notes: This is to say that Brahma has already created such a typical being, namely Jambavanta, prior to all the gods, as a role model in creation.

glosses.meaning: in earlier times, only, by me, created

verses.devanagari:
ते तथोक्ता भगवता तत् प्रतिश्रुत्य शासनम् |
जनयामासुरेवं ते पुत्रान् वानररूपिणः
verses.iast:
te tathā uktāḥ bhagavatā tat prati śrutya śāsanam |
janayāmāsuḥ evam te putrān vānara rūpiṇaḥ
verses.translation: When Brahma addressed them thus, those gods have agreed to his order and accordingly started to parent sons in the semblance of monkeys.
notes: This pedigree is not yet given the label of monkeys. They are lookalike of monkeys but not monkeys, vāna rūpiṇam resembling monkeys, as said in the verse. The word vanara is vane carati iti vanara-s because they range far and wide over forests they are called vanara-s, but not exactly a monkey race.

verses.devanagari:
ऋषयश्च महात्मानः सिद्धविद्याधरोरगाः |
चारणाश्च सुतान् वीरान् ससृजुर्वनचारिणः
verses.iast:
ṛṣayaḥ ca mahātmānaḥ siddha vidyādhara uragāḥ |
cāraṇāḥ ca sutān vīrān sasṛjuḥ vana cāriṇaḥ
verses.translation: The great-souled celestial groups, namely the sages, siddha-s, vidyaadharaa-s, caarana-s have created valiant sons that are forest rangers.

glosses.meaning: valiant ones, forest, ranging - monkey like

verses.devanagari:
वानरेन्द्रं महेद्राभमिन्द्रो वालिनमात्मजम् |
सुग्रीवं जनयामास तपनस्तपतां वरः
verses.iast:
vānarendram mahendra ābham indraḥ vālinam ātmajam |
sugrīvam janayāmāsa tapanaḥ tapatām varaḥ
verses.translation: Indra procreated the lord of vanara-s, namely Vali, who by his physique is like Mt. Mahendra, and the highest humidifier among all the humidifiers, namely the Sun, procreated Sugreeva.

glosses.meaning: Mt. Mahendra, in sheen of body
among the humidifiers, the great, humidifier [the Sun]

verses.devanagari:
बृहस्पतिस्त्वजनयत्तारं नाम महाकपिम् |
सर्ववानरमुख्यानां बुद्धिमन्तमनुत्तमम्
verses.iast:
bṛhaspatiḥ tu ajanayat tāram nāma mahā kapim |
sarva vānara mukhyānām buddhimantam anuttamam
verses.translation: Brihaspati, the Jupiter, gave rise to a great monkey named Tara, who is the most important one among all vanara-s, and who excels all by his intelligence.
notes: Tara here is a vanara hero but not Lady Tara, the wife of Vali. Here we have the wording of kapiḥ the monkey - for these forest rangers for first time.

glosses.meaning: among all, Vaanaras, the important one
none, better than him - excellent one

verses.devanagari:
धनदस्य सुतः श्रीमान् वानरो गन्धमादनः |
विश्वकर्मा त्वजनयन्नलं नाम महाकपिम्
verses.iast:
dhanadasya sutaḥ śrīmān vānaro gandhamādanaḥ |
viśvakarmā tu ajanayan nalam nāma mahā kapim
verses.translation: The brilliant Gandhamaadana is the son of Kubera, while the divine architect Vishvakarma procreated the great monkey called Nala.

glosses.meaning: divine architect, Vishvakarma, has but [gave rise to]

verses.devanagari:
पावकस्य सुतः श्रीमान्नीलोऽग्नि सदृशप्रभः |
तेजसा यशसा वीर्यादत्यरिच्यत वानरान्
verses.iast:
pāvakasya sutaḥ śrīmān nīlaḥ agni sadṛśa prabhaḥ |
tejasā yaśasā vīryāt atyaricyata vīryavān
verses.translation: The bright son of Fire is Neela whose blaze is like that of fire and who excels other monkeys by his in resplendence, renown and courage.

verses.devanagari:
रूपद्रविणसंपन्नावश्विनौ रूपसंमतौ |
मैन्दं च द्विविदं चैव जनयामासतुः स्वयम्
verses.iast:
rUpa draviṇa sampannau aśvinau rUpasaṃmatau |
maindam ca dvividam ca eva janayāmāsatuḥ svayam
verses.translation: The Ashwin twin gods whose wealth is their beautiful appearance have personally procreated two vanara-s namely Mainda and Dvivida, blessing them with beautiful appearance.

glosses.meaning: beautifulness, called wealth, having [beauty being their wealth, property]

verses.devanagari:
वरुणो जनयामास सुषेणं नाम वानरम् |
शरभं जनयामास पर्जन्यस्तु महाबलम्
verses.iast:
varuṇo janayāmāsa suṣeṇam nāma vānaram |
śarabham janayāmāsa parjanyaḥ tu mahābalaḥ
verses.translation: The Rain-god procreated the vanara named Susheshana, and Thunder-god gave rise to the great mighty Sharabha.

verses.devanagari:
मारुतस्यौरसः श्रीमान् हनुमान्नाम वानरः |
वज्रसंहननोपेतो वैनतेयसमो जवे
सर्ववानरमुख्येषु बुद्धिमान् बलवानपि |
verses.iast:
mārutasya aurasaḥ śrīmān hanumān nāma vānaraḥ |
vajra saṃhananopeto vainateya samaḥ jave
sarva vānara mukhyeṣu buddhimān balavān api |
verses.translation: The direct son of Air-god is the marvellous and adventurous Hanuma with an indestructible body, and one identical in the speed of lady Vinata's son, namely Garuda, the divine eagle vehicle of Vishnu, and among all monkey chiefs he is the intelligent and the indefatigable one too.
notes: Garuda: The bird and vehicle of Vishnu. He is generally represented as a being something between a man and a bird and considered as the sovereign of the feathered race. He may be compared with the Simurgh of the Persians, the Ank of the Arabs, the Griffin of chivalry [without lion's body,] the Phoenix of Egypt, and the bird that sits upon the ash Yggdrasil of the Edda. - Griffith.

glosses.meaning: lady Vinata's son, [Garuda, the divine eagle vehicle of Vishnu]

verses.devanagari:
ते सृष्टा बहुसाहस्रा दशग्रीववधोद्यताः
अप्रमेयबला वीरा विक्रान्ताः कामरूपिणः |
verses.iast:
te sṛṣṭā bahu sāhasrā daśagrīva vadhe udyatāḥ
aprameya balā vīrā vikrāntāḥ kāma rūpiṇaḥ |
verses.translation: Thus the gods have procreated many thousands of such valorous and guise changing monkeys who with their immeasurable strength and bravery are manifest for the elimination of the decahedral demon Ravana.

verses.devanagari:
ते गजाचलसंकाशा वपुष्मंतो महाबलाः
ऋक्षवानरगोपुच्छाः क्षिप्रमेवाभिजज्ञिरे |
verses.iast:
te gaja acala saṅkāśā vapuṣmanto mahābalāḥ
ṛkṣa vānara gopucchāḥ kṣipram eva abhijajñire |
verses.translation: And they with their elephantine, mountainous and prodigious bodies quickly took birth in bears, monkeys, sacred langoors.

verses.devanagari:
यस्य देवस्य यद्रूपं वेषो यश्च पराक्रमः
अजायत समं तेन तस्य तस्य पृथक् पृथक् |
verses.iast:
yasya devasya yad rūpam veṣo yaḥ ca parākramaḥ
ajāyata samam tena tasya tasya pṛthak pṛthak |
verses.translation: Those that are procreated have attained the shape, getup and valour of the god that has fathered them, and thus the monkey race is procreated separately and individually.

verses.devanagari:
गोलांगूलीषु चोत्पन्नाः केचिदुन्नतविक्रमाः
ऋक्षीषु च तथा जाता वानराः किंनरीषु च |
verses.iast:
golāngūleṣu ca utpannāḥ kiñcid unnata vikramāḥ
ṛkṣīṣu ca tathā jātā vānarāḥ kiṃnarīṣu ca |
verses.translation: Some of the vanara-s endowed with superior valour are born to female langoors, and like that some more to female bears and kinnaraa-s.

verses.devanagari:
देवा महर्षिगन्धर्वास्तार्क्ष्या यक्षा यशस्विनः
नागाः किंपुरुषाश्चैव सिद्धविद्याधरोरगाः |
बहवो जनयामासुर्हृष्टास्तत्र सहस्रशः
चारणाश्च सुतान् वीरान् ससृजुर्वनचारिणः |
वानरान् सुमहाकायान् सर्वान् वै वनचारिणः
अप्सरस्सु च मुख्यासु तदा विद्यधरीषु च |
नागकन्यासु च तथा गन्धर्वीणां तनूषु च |
verses.iast:
devā maharṣi gandharvāḥ tārxya yaxā yaśasvinaḥ
nāgāḥ kimpuruṣāḥ ca eva siddha vidyādhara uragāḥ |
bahavo janayāmāsuḥ hṛṣṭāḥ tatra sahasraśaḥ
cāraṇāḥ ca sutān vīrān sasṛjuḥ vana cāriṇaḥ |
vānarān su mahākāyān sarvān vai vana cāriṇaḥ
apsarassu ca mukhyāsu tadā vidyadharīṣu ca |
nāga kanyāsu ca tadā gandharvīṇām tanUṣu ca |
verses.translation: Several of the gods, great-sages, gandharva-s, eagles, yaksha-s, and the celebrated reptiles, kimpusha-s, siddha-s, vidyaadharaa-s, uraga-s and caarana-s and even the prominent maidens of apsara-s, she-vidyaadharaa-s, naaga, gandharva-s then gladly procreated all of the thousands of forest-ranging and valiant vanara sons from their bodies that are forest rangers. [21b, 22, 23, 24a, b]

glosses.meaning: in female gandharva, from the bodies, also

verses.devanagari:
कामरूपबलोपेता यथाकामं विचारिणः
सिंहशार्दूलसदृशा दर्पेण च बलेन च |
verses.iast:
kāma rUpa balopetā yathā kāma vicāriṇaḥ
siṃha śārdUla sadṛśā darpeṇa ca balena ca |
verses.translation: They are endowed with guise changing faculties, with bodily might and by their pride and might are identical to lions and tigers, and they are born-free in their movement in forests.

glosses.meaning: according, their wish, they move freely - born free

verses.devanagari:
शिलाप्रहरणाः सर्वे सर्वे पादपयोधिनः
नखदंष्ट्रायुधाः सर्वे सर्वे सर्वास्त्रकोविदाः |
verses.iast:
śilā praharaṇāḥ sarve sarve parvata yodhinaḥ
nakha danṣṭra āyudhāḥ sarve sarve sarva astra kovidāḥ |
verses.translation: All of them are the assaulters with stones, and all are the attackers with trees, and all have their nails and claws as their weapons, yet all are experts in missiles.
notes: Rama and Lakshmana will use arrows and missiles as their weaponry in the ensuing final war with Ravana. The vanara soldiers use stones, trees, and their own claws and nails. The golden maces or clubs handled by Hanuma, Sugreeva, and Vali usually depicted in pictures are for more mythical ornamentation to glorify the characters. However, these Vaanaras are well versed in the knowledge of such tactical weaponry, only to save themselves from their usage against them, but do not use them necessarily. In Sundara Kanda Hanuma will be tied by a magical weapon called Brahma astra when he is in Lanka. Though knowing the release from that Brahma astra, Hanuma does not utilise that knowledge there.

glosses.meaning: all kinds of, missiles, experts in.

verses.devanagari:
विचालयेयुः शैलेन्द्रान् भेदयेयुः स्थिरान् द्रुमान्
क्षोभयेयुश्च वेगेन समुद्रं सरितां पतिम् |
verses.iast:
vicāla yeyuḥ śailendrān bheda yeyuḥ sthirān drumān
kṣobha yeyuḥ ca vegena samudram saritām patim |
verses.translation: They can rock greatest mountains, rip firm rooted trees, and with their speed they can agitate the of lord of rivers, namely the ocean.

verses.devanagari:
दारयेयुः क्षितिं पद्भ्यामाप्लवेयुर्महार्णवम्
नभस्थलं विशेयुश्च गृह्णीयुरपि तोयदान् |
verses.iast:
dāra yeyuḥ kṣitim padbhyām āplaveyuḥ mahā arṇavan
nabhasthalam viśeyur ca gṛhṇīyur api toyadān |
verses.translation: They can shatter the ground with their two feet, leap and cross over great oceans, and they can seize the clouds entering arch of heaven.

glosses.meaning: with their two feet, ground, they cleave, shatter
great ocean, they leap and cross over
sky, surface of - arch of heaven

verses.devanagari:
गृह्णीयुरपि मातंगान् मत्तान् प्रव्रजतो वने
नर्दमानाश्च नादेन पातयेयुर्विहंगमान् |
verses.iast:
gṛhṇīyur api mātaṅgān mattān pravrajato vane
nardamānāḥ ca nādena pāta yeyuḥ vihaṅgamān |
verses.translation: They can catch ruttish elephants that tumultuously move in forests, and just with the sound of their blare they make sky flying birds to fall.

glosses.meaning: in the forests, verily [tumultuously,] moving about
the flying birds, they make them fall.

verses.devanagari:
ईदृशानां प्रसूतानि हरीणां कामरूपिणाम्
शतं शतसहस्राणि यूथपानां महात्मनाम् |
verses.iast:
īdṛśānām prasūtāni harīṇām kāma rūpiṇām
śatam śata sahasrāṇi yūthapānām mahātmanām |
verses.translation: Thus the gods and others have procreated millions of such noble souled Vaanaras as the chiefs of warriors who can change their guise at their wish.

verses.devanagari:
ते प्रधानेषु यूथेषु हरीणां हरियूथपाः
बभूवुर्यूथपश्रेष्ठा वीरांश्चाजनयन् हरीन् |
verses.iast:
te pradhāneṣu yUtheṣu harīṇām hariyUthapāḥ
babhūvur yūthapa śreṣṭhān vīrām ca ajanayan harīn |
verses.translation: Those vanara generals who took birth thus became the prominent generals among the principle battalions of monkeys, and they have also procreated brave monkeys on their own.

verses.devanagari:
अन्ये ऋक्षवतः प्रस्थानुपतस्थुः सहस्रशः
अन्ये नानाविधान् शैलान् काननानि च भेजिरे |
verses.iast:
anye ṛkṣavataḥ prasthān upatasthuḥ sahasraśaḥ
anye nānā vidhān śailān kānanāni ca bhejire |
verses.translation: Some thousands of them stayed on the ridges of Mt. Riskshavat while others reached many kinds of other mountains and forests.

glosses.meaning: Mt. Riskshavat, on ridges, are staying

verses.devanagari:
सूर्यपुत्रं च सुग्रीवं शक्रपुत्रं च वालिनम्
भ्रातरावुपतस्थुस्ते सर्वे च हरियूथपाः |
नलं नीलं हनूमन्तमन्यांश्च हरियूथपान्
verses.iast:
sūrya putram ca sugrīvam śakra putram ca vālinam
bhrātarau upatasthuḥ te sarve ca hari yūthapāaḥ |
nalam nīlam hanUmantam anyāṃśca hari yUthapān
verses.translation: All of the monkeys stood by the brothers, namely the son of Indra Vali, and the son of sun Sugreeva, and even with the monkey generals like Nala, Neela and Hanuma et al.

verses.devanagari:
ते तार्क्ष्यबलसंपन्नाः सर्वे युद्धविशारदाः |
विचरन्तोऽर्दयन् दर्पात् सिंहव्याघ्रमहोरगान्
verses.iast:
te tārkśya bala sampannāḥ sarve yuddha viśāradāḥ |
vicaranto'rdayan sarvān siṃha vyāghra mahoragān
verses.translation: All of those who are well-versed in warfare and endowed with the might of divine eagle Garuda, used to thwart the pride of lions, tigers and great snakes just by their own prideful subjugation while they move about the forests.

glosses.meaning: like Divine Eagle, Garuda, might, endowed with
by their pride - prideful subjugation as they do not kill them

verses.devanagari:
महाबलो महाबाहुर्वाली विपुलविक्रमः |
जुगोप भुजवीर्येण ऋक्षगोपुच्छवानरान्
verses.iast:
mahābalo mahābāhuḥ vālī vipula vikramaḥ |
jugopa bhuja vīryeṇa ṛxa gopuccha vānarān
verses.translation: He who is adroit, extremely mighty, and highly indomitable, that Vali protected bears, langoors, and monkeys just by the strength of his arms.

verses.devanagari:
तैरियं पृथिवी शूरैः सपर्वतवनार्णवा |
कीर्णा विविधसंस्थानैर्नानाव्यंजनलक्षणैः
verses.iast:
taiḥ iyam pṛdhvī śUraiḥ saparvata vana arṇavā |
kīrṇā vividha saṃsthānaiḥ nānā vyañjana laxaṇaiḥ
verses.translation: The earth with its mountains, forests and oceanward places is overspread with those brave ones that possess diverse physiques and peculiar indication marks of their stock.

glosses.meaning: many, physical, indications [indicating their peculiar race]
with mountains, forests, and oceans [oceanward provinces]

verses.devanagari:
तैर्मेघबृन्दाचलकूटसंनिभैः
महाबलैर्वानरयूथपाधिपैः |
बभूव भूर्भीमशरीररूपैः
समावृता रामसहायहेतोः
verses.iast:
taiḥ megha bṛndācala kUṭa saṃnibhaiḥ
mahābalaiḥ vānara yūthapa adhipaiḥ |
babhūva bhūḥ bhīma śarīra rūpaiḥ
samāvṛtā rāma sahāya hetoḥ
verses.translation: The earth is thus suffused with those mighty army generals of Vanara race whose physiques resembled the clusters of clouds and peaks of mountains, and who have emerged for the reason of helping Rama.
